title: Zelensky dismisses Defense Minister Mykhailo Fedorov
body:
On 15 July 2026, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky dismissed Defense Minister Mykhailo Fedorov after a meeting with military leadership, according to the Kyiv Independent. Fedorov had served as defense minister for about six months and, before that, as digital transformation minister from 2019 to 2026. Interior Minister Ihor Klymenko was reportedly offered the defense post, and parliament was expected to vote on a nomination on 16 July.

Lawmakers and analysts linked the dismissal to a conflict between Fedorov and Commander-in-Chief Oleksandr Syrskyi. Zelensky cited a rift between the Defense Ministry and military leadership, as well as draft and mobilization issues. Fedorov was credited with persuading SpaceX chief executive Elon Musk to deny Russia access to Starlink in February 2026, with launching a campaign called "logistics lockdown" on 27 May and with starting military reforms in June.

Veteran and activist Dmytro Koziatynskyi called for protests in Kyiv. Serhii Sternenko, an adviser to Fedorov, said on 15 July that he would stop advising the Defense Ministry. Fedorov wrote: "We needed to be even more decisive in dismissing those who were hindering change."
